race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: FOREVER NOAH wasn't seen to anything like best effect on his return at Wolverhampton and is taken to bounce back in style and bag a second C&D success now tried in new headgear. Fellow C&D scorer Henry Tudor is next on the list, although Saeculamation and Starsong can also play a prominent role. FOREVER NOAH HENRY TUDOR SAECULAMATION (IRE)
